description:
¿Qué pasa cuando el Psytrance Mexicano se encuentra cara a cara con la nueva generación del trap latino?

Hace más de dos años nació una idea que parecía imposible: fusionar la identidad psicodélica de EL MEXiCANO PT II con la actitud desafiante de ZIPLOCK, creando un mashup capaz de conectar dos escenas que, aunque distintas en sonido, comparten el mismo espíritu underground.

Desde entonces, este track se convirtió en un arma secreta dentro de mis sets. Festivales, raves y pistas de baile alrededor de Mexico y Estados Unidos fueron moldeando una versión que evolucionó junto a la energía de la gente.

Hace unos días ocurrió algo inesperado.

Durante un rave en Teotihuacán, alguien grabó un fragmento de mi presentación y lo compartió en redes. El video comenzó a circular de forma completamente orgánica hasta llegar a personas fuera de la escena psytrance... e incluso terminó llegando a **EMJAY**, quien descubrió el mashup gracias a esa grabación hecha por un asistente del evento.

Lo que comenzó como un momento espontáneo dentro de un rave mexicano terminó convirtiéndose en una conversación entre dos mundos musicales que rara vez coinciden.

Porque más allá de géneros, BPMs o etiquetas, existe algo que conecta a ambas culturas: la rebeldía, la identidad propia, la libertad creativa y el amor por la música hecha desde la calle, el underground y la comunidad.

description:
🌌 Another Mission, Another World · ICT · DJ Lexo
From the album Here We Go On Another Mission Yet Again

What happens when one mission leads to another reality?

“Another Mission, Another World” expands the universe established in Here We Go On Another Mission, stepping beyond familiar coordinates into parallel possibilities and unseen futures. Inspired by the thought-provoking themes of Orphan Black, Counterpart, and Foundation, this track explores identity, consequence, and the idea that every choice may open the door to another path.

Atmospheric synths, cinematic textures, and a steady electronic pulse create the feeling of crossing dimensions while remaining anchored to purpose. There is wonder in the unknown, but also responsibility. Different worlds may follow different rules, yet the mission continues: adapt, discover, and keep moving forward.

Rather than revisiting the past, this track asks listeners to imagine what lies just beyond it. Another signal. Another timeline. Another version of the journey waiting to unfold.

🎧 The coordinates have changed. The mission remains.
title: 08-Another Mission, Another World

description:
En fløyte kaller i det fjerne, kan du høre dens kall?
Nok en drøm dør av en sprøyte, nok et liv forgår.
Hvor ofte har du åpnet et kjøleskap uten mat?
Hvor ofte har du plukket flasker for å få penger til en melk?
Hvor mange netter har du sovet i bilen, fordi bilen er det du har?
Sett andre barn få julegaver, som dine egne ikke får?
Høstbladene faller.
Fargene går mot brunt.
Vinteren er snart et faktum.
Respekten for liv er død.
Vår Herre kom med et budskap, men budskapet, det er glemt.
Vi synger julesanger for å minnes, men budskapet, det er gjemt.
For «oss og dem» er dagens gospel.
Og «Gud» har blitt en floskel.
En munk roper sin smerte, kan du høre hans rop?
Snart velger han bort livet i stillhet, for ingen kan eller vil.
Og alle kirker de stenges, mens vi dør av isolasjon.
Og alle templer lukker dørene, synagogen den er stengt,
I moskeen er lysene slukket, ingen bønner ropes ut.
En tåre faller fra himmelen, regnbuefarget mot jord.
Krystallsnø dekker bakken.
Visker alt bort med hvitt.
Og jorden den skriker sin smerte.
Respekten for liv er død.
Et barn med arr på arrene lengter etter fred.
En kvinne ser sin siste dråpe falle, så faller kniven ned.
En uteligger trekker soveposen opp, og drømmer om litt ro.
På NAV spiser de hjortefilet med en god Chablis.
På NAV spiser de hjortefilet med en god Chablis.

description:
Oh, nena...
Ya es hora de irse, veo.
No vayas todavía.
Oyere, por favor.

La discoteca acaba de apagar las luces de neón,
el piso huele a bebidas fortificadas y humo débil.
Tus ojos miran a través, flotando casi, y yo escucho
el eco de tus besos. Tú me estás diciendo que ya es hora de ir,
pero tus manos en mi cintura están diciendo queda un rato más.
Quedate un poquito más, ya te vienen las primeras amanecidas.

Llega ese aroma caro mezclado con rum,
y todo el mundo se nos transforma en un lugar 
más pequeño cuando nos abrazas de esa manera.

Sé que mañana volverás a la complicación,
a las dudas, a la distancia, a estar sin mí.
Pero la calle se hace fría esta noche, quedate un poco conmigo,
párgatelo a mí, olvídate de mis palabras.

Quedate en mis labios...
Un segundo más, antes de que salga el sol.
Que se nos quemé la piel, que perdamos el control.
Si mañana me olvidas, te prometo que no me importa nada,
pero ahora aprieta este momento, porque la noche es corta.
Quedate en mis labios.

Tu siempre me dijiste que lo nuestro es locura,
que somos como agua y aceite, y que jamás funcionaría.
Pero cuando la bachata bajar y la penumbra se asoma,
no piensas en el mañana, simplemente te dejas llevar.

Te mordí el cuello y me dejaste sin aire,
y ahí lo entiendo: no quieres que esto termine.

Quedate en mis labios...
Un segundo más, antes de que salga el sol.
Que se nos queme la piel, que se nos vaya el control.
Si mañana me olvidas, te prometo que no te lo juzgaré,
pero ahora mordisquea este instante, porque la noche es corta.
Quedate en mis labios.

La ciudad comienza a despertar fuera,
Estás tan delicado como el toque,
Que la guitarra siga su pulso, danza para la melodía.
Que el dolor tenga un ritmo… con un gran embestida.
Así es.

Quedate en mis labios,
Por un segundo más, antes que el sol aparezca.
Que nos vaya la piel, dejen de controlarse.
Si mañana te olvido, juro que lo acepto sin problemas,
pero por ahora abraza este momento, la noche es corta.
Quedate en mis labios…

La ciudad duerme afuera, alargándose,
y en esta habitación aún no es de día si quieres tú.
Déjame desprenderte, quítatelo de encima,
No te sueltes, quítate y déjame saborear tu boca para la semana.
Quedate en mis labios…
Durante un ratito más.
De eso.
title: Quédate en mis labios

description:
**THE LONGEST NIGHT — DOLPHIN 007**

*The Longest Night* is a cinematic rock journey through mystery, memory, and the unexplained.

Set against a vast nocturnal seascape, the song follows the story of a man haunted not by loss, but by an encounter he cannot forget — a woman who appeared beyond the boundaries of reason, somewhere between legend and reality.

Built on tension, atmosphere, and a slow-burning progression, the music unfolds like a secret gradually revealing itself. Sparse acoustic textures, intelligent synthesizer landscapes, powerful guitars, and a monumental drum arrival create an experience that is both immersive and commanding.

Rather than offering answers, *The Longest Night* explores the enduring power of mystery itself — the rare moments in life that remain beyond explanation, yet continue to shape who we become.

Dark, sophisticated, and cinematic, this is a song about the things that cannot be possessed, cannot be understood, and can never truly be forgotten.
title: The longest Night

perduto in mezzo a un polveroso prato.

agli altri ed a se stesso amico,

stampa sopra uno scalcinato muro!

sì qualche storta sillaba e secca come un ramo.

description: Alchemical [Fusion]'s narrative is woven from the words of J. Robert Oppenheimer, who famously declared "I am become Death, destroyer of worlds" as he witnessed the first atomic blast. The track's haunting harmonies and driving rhythms evoke the apocalyptic consequences of nuclear war, as eerie audio clips from Harry Truman's announcement of the atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki eerily underscore the song's themes. Through a maelstrom of soaring guitar solos and pounding drumbeats, "Alechmical [Fusion]" probes the dark heart of humanity's most devastating creation, leaving the listener to ponder the devastating consequences of our destructive potential.
title: Alchemical [Fusion]

Testo e composizione ispirata al libro di Herman Melville “Moby Dick” Dalla storia epica di Melville, al tema che affronta la terribile e inaccettabile caccia alle balene. La caccia commerciale purtroppo non è l’unico pericolo che le balene devono fronteggiare. I cambiamenti climatici, l’inquinamento chimico e acustico, l’aumento del traffico marittimo, lo sfruttamento eccessivo delle risorse ittiche, sono tutti impatti provocati dall’uomo che mettono in serio pericolo la sopravvivenza delle ultime popolazioni di balene rimaste. Difendiamo questo tesoro straordinario che va protetto e che subisce gli impatti devastanti dell’inquinamento e delle attività umane. 
STOP KILLING ! SAVE THE WHALES!

Avevo soltanto vent’anni e mi sembravan tanti, attraverso quel desiderio di suonare ed esplorare il mondo musicale. Così innamorato della Musica, non potevo che dedicare qualcosa di mio, di profondamente personale, a quella ragazza che mi aveva rapito il cuore. “Canzone per Marina”, nacque tra le corde della mia chitarra, in modo spontaneo, senza cercarla. Feci mio l’estro compositivo e in breve trascrissi gli accordi armonici della mia prima composizione.
Non molto tempo più tardi, colsi l’occasione per donare a Marina la mia composizione. Fu un successo.

description:
There’s a specific kind of hunger that doesn’t end with a full stomach. Sweet Tooth For Trouble is a simple, jagged, driving acoustic piece about the kind of bad decisions that feel like a good idea until the exact moment they fall apart. A confession from someone who knows better, but does it anyway. 

The song explores the "same old song, same old flame" cycle of toxic patterns with a blend of self-deprecating humor and sharp observation. It’s an anthem for the restless, perfect for late-night drives where the destination doesn't matter as much as the momentum. Dry, organic, and relentlessly real.

Genre: Country Noir / Alt-Country
Mood: Edgy, driving, cynical, restless

description: "Echo of Us" tells the story of two people haunted by memories of a past love. It begins with quiet, everyday moments—the taste of cold coffee, a song on the radio—that trigger longing and loss. The narrator reflects on laughter once shared and now replaced by silence, showing how pride and fear of vulnerability kept them from expressing love. As the song progresses, both voices convey the inner struggle between wanting to reconnect and the inevitability of separation. Solos and instrumental textures mirror emotional tension. By the final chorus and outro, the song portrays acceptance: the love remains in memory, the echo of their connection lingering, tender, bittersweet, and haunting.
title: Echo of Us

description:
Yeah...
Dime hasta cuándo, mami.
Dale mambo...
Escucha esta nueva bachata de Ochenta Y Dos

Son le tres de la mañana y vi tu "like" en mi foto.
Sé de qué vas, juegas con mi mente como si nada.
Me dejas en visto tres días, me dejas medio roto,
y luego apareces en mi cama, toda callada.

Pero de santa no tienes nada, y eso es lo que me encanta.
Ya me conozco el truco, esa carita de santa,

Me dices que me quieres, pero después te vas con tus amigas,
me subes una story pa' que vea que estás bien.
Me estás quemando el coco con tantas mentiras,
pero si me llamas, caigo otra vez, de cero a cien.
Es que el orgullo no me sirve cuando estás de frente.

Y otra vez caigo en tu juego,
ese que me quema por dentro, que me quita el sueño.
Tú juegas a perder e io juego a que soy tu dueño.
Me tienes dando vueltas en el mismo callejón,
sabiendo que juegas con fuego...
pero qué rico sabe tu juego.

Aquí el ritmo baja un poco, más íntimo, estilo bachata-pop
Ayer te vi en la discoteca, andabas con un tipo.
Le sonreías igualito que me sonreías a mí.
Te juro que por un segundo casi que me muero, casi pego un grito,
pero entendí que ese es tu estilo, que tú eres así.
Te gusta que te rueguen, te gusta la atención,
y yo como un idiota escribiendo esta canción (Yo soy Ochenta Y Dos).

Y otra vez caigo en tu juego,
ese que me quema por dentro, que me quita el sueño.
Tú juegas a perder e io juego a que soy tu dueño.
Me tienes dando vueltas en el mismo callejón,
sabiendo que juegas con fuego...
pero qué rico sabe tu juego.

¡Suéltala!
¡Eso es!
Dime por qué me haces esto...
Si tú sabes que me tienes en la palma de tu mano.

Tú juegas a perder e io juego a que soy tu dueño.
Me tienes dando vueltas en el mismo callejón,
sabiendo que juegas con fuego...
ese que me quema por dentro, 
que me quita el sueño.

Ya no sé si borrar tu número o llamarte ahora mismo.
Tú ganas, siempre ganas.
Mañana me ignoras, pero el viernes volvemos al mismo abismo.
Es tu juego...
Y yo ya soy tu juguete.
Quédate con la victoria.
Yeah.
title: Tu juego

description:
El Venezolano tiene una forma única de hablar y una de ellas es cuando utilizamos las frutas en nuestro dialecto para referirnos a caracaterísticas o cualidades de las personas, La Frutería es una referencia de ello, una canción para divertir, hacer reir, disfrutar.

Letra y Música: Carlos Funes, Iván Funes, Nico Acosta.
Mezclado y Masterizado por Jonatan Angarita en Estudio Coahuila135, Ciudad de México.

Mira el video aqui / Watch the video here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4sEhsqVOrlc 

Venezuelans have a unique way of speaking and one of them is when we use fruits in our dialect to refer to characteristics or qualities of people. La Frutería is a reference to this, a song to entertain, make people laugh, and enjoy.

Lyrics and Music: Carlos Funes, Iván Funes, Nico Acosta.
Mixed and Mastered by Jonatan Angarita at Estudio Coahuila135, Mexico City.

description:
I’d like to dedicate this song as a tribute to my late music partner, Hans Ottsen. We always performed this as an instrumental, and I wanted to share with you my love for the words. Since the pandemic, I’ve been listening to the great jazz women of the past. These include: Ella Fitzgerald, Sarah Vaughan, and Dinah Washington. I’m learning so much from their recordings, whether it’s the classic 1950s, or their final decades.

For the piano sound, I chose the new Nord Felt Upright, extra large sample, which I downloaded around March. To make the piano sound like a grand, I selected the bright filter on my Nord Grand 88. It’s the perfect piano sound for getting that stripped down, laid-back sound, like the classic recordings of the 1950s.

Hope you’ll enjoy it.

Music by Johnny Green
Lyrics by Edward Heyman, Robert Sour, Frank Eyton

description:
Scáth agus Solas (Shadow and Light), the 2nd movement of Cúigréad (Quintet).

The title of this work translates from Irish as "Quintet: Shadow and Light."

This is about the inner play of shadow and light on various surfaces.

The more rhythmic the music is the more intricate the surface is. You may imagine any number of buildings or landscapes with instances of shadow and light interspersed.

A canyon, a statue, a still-life, the facade of modern office building, a Greek statue, the sun and the moon, clouds and sun/moon-beams, the dreamy ever trickle of light through green bokeh leaves.

The dance of light on fountains, the dance of light off the marathon runners, light on you as you walk late at night down an empty street, and you remember and remember and remember...

Until its you
who is dancing [[inside the depths of your soul.]]
title: Scáth agus Solas

description:
Franz Peter Schubert (31 January 1797 – 19 November 1828) was an Austrian composer of the late Classical and early Romantic eras. Despite his short life, Schubert left behind a vast oeuvre, including more than 600 secular vocal works (mainly Lieder), seven complete symphonies, sacred music, operas, incidental music, and a large body of piano and chamber music. His major works include the art songs "Erlkönig", "Gretchen am Spinnrade", and "Ave Maria"; the Trout Quintet; the Symphony No. 8 in B minor (Unfinished); the Symphony No. 9 in C major (Great); the String Quartet No. 14 in D minor (Death and the Maiden); the String Quintet in C major; the Impromptus for solo piano; the last three piano sonatas; the Fantasia in F minor for piano four hands; the opera Fierrabras; the incidental music to the play Rosamunde; and the song cycles Die schöne Müllerin, Winterreise and Schwanengesang.

Appreciation of Schubert's music while he was alive was limited to a relatively small circle of admirers in Vienna, but interest in his work increased greatly in the decades following his death. Felix Mendelssohn, Robert Schumann, Franz Liszt, Johannes Brahms and other 19th-century composers discovered and championed his works. Today, Schubert is considered one of the greatest composers in the history of Western classical music and his music continues to be widely performed.

description:
The party had all finally gotten back from their respective quests. The group had to disband for some time to achieve their personal goals. No hard feelings. 

They all met back at the Tavern. Back at the original tavern that they met at. The same tavern that their groups Barbarian had a crush on the barkeep. Always amusing to see a giant barbarian get giddy at the thought of some companionship. 

One by one, they trickled into the tavern. Sitting in their back corner table, at last, the entire group was back. 

A slightly older barmaid strolled through the back kitchen with a plate full of drinks. She gasped, tripped, and promptly dropped all of the food and drink that was headed to fellow tavern goers. 

The party laughed and immediately all got up to help the poor lass. Finally, the group had come home. 

Maybe this time she'd get her chance to speak with the barbarian after all. In the midst of curses and flustered cleaning, the barmaid was the happiest she'd been in years.
title: Tavern Tales

description:
Histoire du Tango attempts to convey the history and evolution of the tango in four movements: Bordel 1900, Café 1930, Nightclub 1960, and Concert d'aujourd'hui. Piazzolla provided program notes that expand on the individual movements.

Café, 1930 is another age of the tango. People stopped dancing it as they did in 1900, preferring instead simply to listen to it. It became more musical, and more romantic. This tango has undergone total transformation: the movements are slower, with new and often melancholy harmonies. Tango orchestras come to consist of two violins, two concertinas, a piano, and a bass. The tango is sometimes sung as well.

Performed by Anna Konoplyova - violin

In the year 1281a.d. the Mongol king Kublai khan ordered his army to invade Japan. With 900 ships and 150,000 soldiers the Mongols crossed the sea of Japan. Invaders who drifted into shore were quickly captured and beheaded. the mighty typhoon kamikaze had saved the people of japan from the indignity of a brutal Mongol invasion and occupation. these events will forever be known as THE STORM OF TSUSHIMA.

Songwriter and production duo Eli & Fur return to Anjunadeep with ‘Temptation’, the first single following the release of their debut album ‘Found In The Wild’.

Released in June 2021, ‘Found In The Wild’ has accumulated over 30 million streams across streaming platforms, received glowing reviews from Mixmag, DJ Mag, Clash Magazine, and Billboard and support across BBC Radio 1 from Pete Tong, Danny Howard and Sian Eleri, which culminated in an Essential Mix that the station themselves described as ‘epic and emotive; deep and devastating’.

Since the release of ‘Found In The Wild’, Eli & Fur have performed at some of the most iconic venues and festivals on the planet including London’s Printworks, Brooklyn Mirage, The Gorge Amphitheatre and Tomorrowland, on top of debuting on the acclaimed tastemaker label Cercle with a breathtaking live stream from the Italian Alps.

description:
After becoming one of the most buzzed-about names in UK minimal tech house last year with his
electrifying flip of Nate Dogg’s “6 in the Morning,” Flex (UK) returns — this time with a legendary co-sign
and a record that’s primed to shake the global dance scene.

The rising DJ/producer, known for his hypnotic grooves and left-of-center flips, first captured the
underground’s attention with a string of viral tracks that racked up millions of streams and earned DJ
support from all corners of the scene. But his latest move might be his boldest yet.

In collaboration with FUNKSHWAY — the LA-based label behind some of dance music’s hottest new DJs,
including breakout talent AYYBO—Flex has flipped Ciara’s iconic “Get Up” into a bass-heavy,
minimalist tech roller titled “So & So”. First teased on TikTok and SoundCloud, the track exploded across
social media, amassing over 5 million views in just a few days and instantly igniting curiosity from both
fans and industry insiders.

The viral energy caught the attention of Ciara herself, who was so impressed by Flex’s take on her 2006
classic that she stepped into the studio and re-recorded her vocals — elevating the track with a fresh,
empowered performance that bridges her early 2000s sound with today’s underground energy.
The result is a powerful meeting of eras and cultures: Ciara’s timeless vocals riding Flex’s stripped-down,
groove-forward production. A full-circle moment for club culture, radio, and social virality.

“So & So” by Flex (UK) & Ciara is set for release on May 9th via FUNKSHWAY and doesn’t just remix a
classic—it rewrites the rulebook for how dance music evolves across generations. As UK minimal tech
surges globally, this track offers a bold blueprint for what’s next.

description:
Doechii’s “Booty Drop” was too good to leave alone.

The original’s vocals and melodic hooks hit immediately — there was something in the pocket of that track that was begging to be pushed harder. So NAME DROP did what made sense: trapped it out. Modern trap drums, sub-heavy bass drops, and a rolling beat that shifts the energy without losing what made the source material work in the first place.

The result sits somewhere between trapstep and UK bass — 141 BPM, F#m, with just enough of the original’s DNA to feel familiar and enough reconstruction to feel like something new. The melodies are still there, just recontextualized. The drop hits differently when the bottom end is this heavy.

This is what a flip should do: respect the original, then take it somewhere it couldn’t go on its own.
title: BOOTY DROP

description:
Wylie Cable - Warmed By The Sun
Dome of Doom
September 23, 2022
Cassette/Digital

Support: WylieCable.lnk.to/WarmedByTheSun

Los Angeles based electronic artist and songwriter Wylie Cable presents his ninth full-length album, Warmed By The Sun. Scheduled for digital and limited edition cassette release via Dome of Doom on September 23, 2022, the 21-track and 51-minute mixtape presents one of the widest arrays in their catalog. From riveting beat mantras soaked in the hazy aftermath of LA nightlife, to the bespoke fertile grounds of unique lyricism and folklore, Warmed By The Sun travels across multitudes of sounds with constant environmental change, bridged by the unmistakable presence of Cable as an artist.

description:
Everything Changes When We Do It in Joy

I go for my morning walk
No rush, no haste
Joy so thick around me
I can almost taste

The kingdom is all around you
When you finally see
Little living reminders
Of how good life can be

A baby bird takes wing
A turtle nesting near
A rabbit and a deer

Reminds me of old Bambi
And I laugh to myself and think
Maybe the kingdom’s already here

Lift up your eyes
Let the sunlight in
Sometimes the miracle
Is where you’ve always been

Everything changes when we do it in joy
Work becomes play
And the kingdom becomes a place where we can stay

Knowing everything happens for a reason
And that’s okay
Everything changes when we do it in joy

I pass an old man sitting
Coffee in his hand
He nods and smiles at nothing
Like he understands

Kids riding bikes in circles
Pure freedom, no plan
The sun breaks through the branches
Like it’s reaching for my hand

We’ve been looking so hard
For something so near
Maybe the kingdom was never hidden
It was always right here

Everything changes when we do it in joy
Work becomes play
And the kingdom becomes a place where we can stay

Knowing everything happens for a reason
And that’s okay
Everything changes when we do it in joy

The baker opens early
Flour on his hands
A mother tying shoelaces
As her little one stands

A bus driver waves hello
To faces he don’t know
Tiny sparks of heaven
Everywhere people go

And I smile to myself again
Like a kid with a brand new toy
Because everything changes
When we do it in joy

Maybe the whole secret
Is as simple as it seems
What we choose to focus on
Becomes the world we see

Everything changes when we do it in joy
Work becomes play
And the kingdom becomes a place where we can stay

Knowing everything happens for a reason
And that’s okay
Everything changes when we do it in joy
title: Injoy
